invariants.requirement: Quotes, brackets, or a colon between a negator and an inventory selector cannot turn that excluded selector into a positive target.
A selector that completes or identifies a target inside the same negative clause remains excluded until an explicit positive contrast or clause boundary.
No excluded selector may become the chosen, prepared, or dispatched entity; unresolved negative scope must fail closed.
A supported 'not A but B' correction may select B while A remains excluded.

non_claims: This hardening is not a new model evaluation.
It does not change, replace, or repair the recorded v1 or v2 metrics.
Passing the added regression matrix does not establish unrestricted natural-language negation understanding.

trigger.summary: Punctuation and long negative scope could cause an excluded inventory label to be interpreted as a positive selector.
